recognize_zh: 大腸腺窩之間的固有層充滿密集的小型深染淋巴球，並夾雜嗜酸性球，腺窩上皮與杯狀細胞保存良好、未見淋巴上皮病灶或腺體破壞，呈現非破壞性的小淋巴球浸潤。
features: Dense lamina propria infiltrate of small lymphocytes with dark round nuclei
Scattered eosinophils admixed in the infiltrate
Crypts intact with preserved goblet cells, no crypt destruction or lymphoepithelial lesions
No large atypical cells, necrosis or germinal centers identified
Mildly edematous stroma in the right side of the field
describe_en: Colonic mucosa shows a dense lamina propria infiltrate of small lymphocytes with round, hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, admixed with scattered eosinophils. The crypts are well preserved with intact goblet cells, and there are no lymphoepithelial lesions, crypt destruction, necrosis or large atypical cells. The monotonous, non-destructive small-cell infiltrate is consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract when supported by CD8-positive phenotype, low Ki-67 and TCR clonality.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytic colitis shows increased intraepithelial lymphocytes with surface epithelial damage and only mild lamina propria expansion by polyclonal cells.
MEITL shows medium-sized cells infiltrating crypt epithelium with CD56 expression and high proliferation.
MALT lymphoma has centrocyte-like or monocytoid B cells, plasmacytic differentiation and lymphoepithelial lesions.
